description: Edit talking-head and short-form video end to end: cut dead space, ums and retakes, add word-timed captions, dynamic visuals and stop motion, then finish the audio at -14 LUFS and export for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. Combines the HyperFrames, Remotion and video-use editing skills with local ffmpeg tools. Use whenever someone wants to edit, cut, tighten or caption a video, or says "cut the dead space", "remove the silences", "cut the ums", "jump cuts", "add captions" or "subtitles", "make this a reel", "add b-roll" or "motion graphics", "make a stop motion", "fix my audio", or drops raw footage that needs to become postable.
